meta.plant_name: Microsoft Osmium Data Center power station

units.notes: I checked the state Title V permit 24-TV-004, issued October 17, 2024. The large Cummins QSK95-G9 fleet agrees with GEM's 100 engines and 300 MW. Four smaller engines are raised as a question.

qa.plant_name: Microsoft Osmium Data Center power station
qa.recommendation: Decide whether to add a small unit for the four smaller engines. Their ratings are in horsepower only, so the capacity would stay blank.
qa.note: The state Title V permit 24-TV-004, issued October 17, 2024, lists about 100 Cummins QSK95-G9 engines, which agrees with GEM's 100 engines and 300 MW. It also lists two Cummins QSK23-G7 engines of 1,220 horsepower and two Cummins QSX15-G9 engines of 755 horsepower that GEM does not carry. Not found: a kilowatt rating for these four engines. A newer application, project 26-332 received September 22, 2026, adds one more QSK95-G9 emergency engine and is not yet issued.

verifications.note: Title V permit 24-TV-004 for the Osmium data center lists QSK95-G9, QSK23-G7 and QSX15-G9 engines.
